neighbours.label: 'and' in a slot where it does not coordinate two parallel words: fixed phrases ('by and large', 'as and when'), a split preposition pair ('created by and owned by'), or after a sentence end, as against ordinary 'A and B' coordination
fire: The weather, by and large, was kind to us during the trip.
Extra staff will be hired as and when the orders come in.
The bakery was founded by and is still run by the same family.
We missed the last bus. and then it started to rain.
Overall the reviews were, by and large, very positive.
The garden was designed by and is cared for by local volunteers.
You can call me as and when you need help with the move.
Nobody answered the door. and the lights were off.
quiet: The weather was kind to us and the roads were clear during the trip.
Extra staff and new trucks will be hired when the orders come in.
The bakery sells bread and cakes made by the same family.
We missed the last bus and the last train home.
Overall the reviews were warm and very positive.
The garden has roses and tulips planted by local volunteers.
You can call me or my brother and sister if you need help.
Nobody answered the door, so we left a note and a cake.
